{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the change
print(f"First few parsed revenue values: {sales['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Confirm that QA orders with 999999.99 are absent
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {(sales['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {(sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum()}")

# Check cross-tabulation again (to confirm no confounding)
print(f"Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n{pd.crosstab(sales['channel'], sales['customer_segment'])}")"}
